patches.reason: local holds the texts of the game: the German ones for a German system, the English ones by default. It is declared without a value and set by the language switch, so TeaseScript sees a value that may be null in the functions that read it. The English texts move from the switch's default branch into the declaration, which the German case replaces as before; nothing else changes. The debug texts, shown only with debuginfo, show how many neighbours there are instead of the list of position pairs, which a TeaseScript text cannot show.
